title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, return the zigzag level order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from left to right, then right to left for the next level and alternate between).
constraints:
0 <= The number of nodes in the tree <= 2000
-100 <= Node.val <= 100
inputFormat: A single line containing space-separated strings mapping the level-order traversal of the tree (`null` for empty nodes).
outputFormat: Print each level's space-separated integer values on a newline in zigzag order.

examples.explanation: Root 3 is L->R. Level 1 is [9, 20], printed R->L as 20, 9. Level 2 is printed L->R.
